estimates.name: Allowance for credit losses
estimates.t: We utilize loan loss forecasting models for estimating expected life-time credit losses, at the individual loan level, for its loan portfolio.

estimates.name: Valuation of financial assets and liabilities carried at fair value
estimates.t: We have established valuation processes and procedures designed so that fair value measurements are appropriate and reliable, that they are based on observable inputs where possible, that the valuation approaches are consistently applied, and the assumptions and inputs are reasonable.
